summary: Two-year ban on producing/selling cultivated meat; signed 2025-06-20, effective 2025-09-01; fines up to $25,000/day. Challenged in federal court by Wildtype and UPSIDE Foods (Institute for Justice).
Bans cultivated meat sales; also challenged by UPSIDE Foods and the Institute for Justice.
Prohibits sale or distribution of cell-cultured meat.
Legislative study including feasibility of a prohibition.
